purpose: Record completed local source-context field extraction for the sixth C2 long-tail source-extraction queue, covering intergenerational, reproductive, maternal-newborn-child, pediatric immunization, lead-exposure, feeding-swallowing, lactation and pediatric oral-health continuity domains while preserving route/manual-review, guideline lineage and model-admission blocks.

currentLimitations: This register completes local source-context field extraction only; it does not complete local review, independent fresh review or reviewed artifact promotion.
Publisher, guideline landing-page and policy-route records require local review or manual fulltext/source-lineage handling before artifact fill.
Guidelines, fact sheets, policy statements and practice portals support bounded framing and endpoint vocabulary; they do not calibrate individual prognosis or intervention effects.
No row authorizes clinical advice, fertility prognosis, pediatric care decisions, lifespan prediction, longevity escape velocity claims or model admission.

sourceAccessNotes: All 24 C2-LT-B6 candidate source rows were checked against official WHO, CDC, ASRM, ESHRE, ACOG, AAP, ASHA, USPSTF, AAPD, OUP, Monash or PMC routes on 2026-07-03.
Publisher or guideline-route rows that may require manual fulltext/source-lineage handling are explicitly marked in sourceAccessStatus rather than treated as fully reviewed evidence.

PCOS, endometriosis, pediatric feeding disorder and several guideline pages are retained as guideline/consensus/source-route context; source-lineage and duplicate route handling remain future local-review tasks.
Fact-sheet and health-topic pages are retained for burden, definition and public-health framing only, not for individual effect-size calibration.
All rows are source-context support only; source existence, official-page availability or article route access does not admit calibrated model parameters.

extractedRows.sourceTitle: Nurturing care for early childhood development: a framework for helping children survive and thrive to transform health and human potential.

extractedRows.endpointDefinition: Candidate endpoints include nurturing-care exposure, early-childhood development support, caregiver responsiveness, nutrition support, safety/security context, early learning exposure and survival/thrive framing.
